summary: Iteration 3 — Klinara Kids Phase-1 upgrade tested end-to-end. Wrote 19 new pytest cases in test_iteration3.py covering auth security (no debug_otp/debug_token leaks), MD user management (list/filter/status-toggle/reset-password with role guards), manual UPI flow (initiate→submit-upi→verify approve/reject + pending-verification list), fee reminder (success on pending / 400 on paid / 403 for parent), and /register-push (returns 'skipped' with placeholder key). All 19 pass. Frontend verified on mobile viewport (390×844): parent-login has no demo hint box, staff-login has no demo accounts box and inputs are empty, MD can navigate Setup → 'User & Login Management', filter chips (All/Parents/Teachers/Admins/MD) render, tapping a user opens action sheet with Deactivate + Reset password, and reset password reveals the temp-pwd-box with Copy. Admin Fees screen renders 'Send Fee Reminder' on pending fees and 'Send Reminder Again' after a reminder has been sent. Minor issue: parent-login TextInput is still pre-populated with the demo phone '9999999999' in useState default — leaks the test phone into the UI even though the visible hint box was removed.

ui_bugs.issue: Phone TextInput has useState('9999999999') default — leaks the mock/test phone into the UI. The 'Demo phone/OTP' hint box was correctly removed, but this default achieves the same leak. Change to useState('').

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' This is expected on web preview; real push only works in a native build. No user-visible impact but confirms the mocked_apis note in the request.
Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Pre-existing from iteration 1/2, non-blocking.

action_items: auth/parent-login.tsx: change `useState('9999999999')` -> `useState('')` on the phone field (line 23) so the demo phone isn't pre-populated in the UI. Same pattern the staff-login already follows (empty defaults).
(Optional) Consider adding `testID` on the parent-login Send OTP button and OTP input for future automated flows — currently the parent OTP path is only exercised via backend.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1895 lines — the previously flagged split into routers (auth.py, users.py, payments.py, etc.) is more urgent this iteration since we added 5 more endpoints in the same file.

GET /api/users returns password-related fields excluded via projection (good), but 'must_change_password' is not surfaced anywhere in the UI — the reset-password flow sets `must_change_password: True` but nothing consumes it. Either wire a change-password screen on first login or drop the flag.

POST /users/{uid}/reset-password prints the temp password in the HTTP response — that is fine for a controlled MD flow, but consider also invalidating any existing JWTs for the target user (e.g., bump a 'token_version' claim). Right now, a deactivated or password-reset user's previously issued token still validates via decode_token because there's no per-user check in get_current_user beyond DB lookup — needs verification: check `get_current_user` for an active/token_version check.

/api/register-push has no auth dependency (`Depends(...)` missing). Anyone can register any user_id + arbitrary device token. Should require `Depends(get_current_user)` and validate `body.user_id == user['id']`.

Admin Fees screen: `Send Fee Reminder` is shown even for `pending_verification` items in some cases — check /app/frontend/app/admin/fees.tsx to ensure the button only shows for pure `pending`; in the screenshots the pending_verification rows correctly do NOT show the button, so this appears fine, but worth a code re-check.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all requested flows verified; one minor issue (parent-login demo phone pre-fill)

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed pending payments for Aarav (parent 9999999999) during the manual UPI + reminder flow tests. They persist in Mongo and now show up on admin/fees. If the visible clutter matters, restart backend and prune payments where description LIKE 'TEST_%'. IMPORTANT: pytest temporarily changed teacher@klinara.com's password to a random temp value. A `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` was executed at end of testing and re-seeds the password back to Teacher@123 (verified via login → 200).
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE_URL from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Iteration 3 endpoints (all under /api): GET /users (md only), PATCH /users/{id}/status (md, cannot self-target -> 400), POST /users/{id}/reset-password (md; 400 for role=parent; returns {temp_password, message}), POST /payments/{id}/submit-upi (parent/staff), POST /payments/{id}/verify {approve, reason} (admin/md), POST /payments/{id}/remind (admin/md; 400 if paid), POST /register-push (currently unauth — see critical_code_review_comments). MOCK_OTP=123456 is enforced server-side; response no longer echoes it. Frontend testIDs added: open-user-management (setup card), filter-{all|parent|teacher|admin|md}, user-{id}, toggle-active-btn, reset-pwd-btn, temp-pwd-box, copy-temp-pwd, remind-{payId}, um-back. Staff login remembers no defaults; parent-login still has '9999999999' as useState default — flagged as UI bug.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no regressions or bugs blocked the flows; the only issue is a low-severity default value in the parent-login phone TextInput (useState('9999999999') in /app/frontend/app/auth/parent-login.tsx:23). Fix: replace with useState('').
